query: /horizons refresh Meridian's prior-artifact.html. Its confirmed WSJF size for enrolment is now stale because most of the work closed; the fleet-view gate has cleared; a newly added component falls outside the frozen baseline. Identify the unresolved decisions before applying changes.
gap: A refresh can leave stale scores, horizon placements and a mismatched baseline without asking the user which changes they want, or silently apply all three.
expected_behavior: Surfaces the stale enrolment scoring decision and asks for its confirmed worksheet if the supplied sources cannot identify it.
Surfaces whether the cleared fleet-view gate should change its horizon, without moving it automatically.
Surfaces whether to approve a new baseline scope or retain the frozen baseline and label the added component separately.
Batches the unresolved choices and waits for user input without inventing approval or modifying the canonical artifact.
must_not: Re-score, move a horizon, rebaseline or publish before the user resolves the pending choices.
Treat absent WSJF data as an approved score or invent its previous numerical value.
